## Summary
Geoffrey Githii (commonly known as Jeff, GitHub handle @yenmulla) is a Software Engineer and System Architect specializing in cross-platform mobile systems (Flutter/Dart), EVM smart contract protocol development (Solidity), scalable full-stack web platforms (React/TypeScript), and distributed edge services.

## Primary Technical Ventures & Experience
- Moonlist Ecosystem (2026 – Present) — Founder & Architect: Engineering an AI-driven multi-chain cryptocurrency aggregator, portfolio analytics dashboard, and non-custodial execution ecosystem across web and mobile.
- Solerium & GOATS Miniapp (2024 – 2025) — Full-Stack Engineer: Designed high-engagement interactive miniapps and user-facing modules optimized for high-volume viral community adoption and high-concurrency state sync.
- Hashbit Org (2022 – 2024) — Lead Smart Contract Developer: Spearheaded EVM protocol architecture, custom fee routing mechanics, liquidity management, and security audits.
- Docswap Exchange (2024) — Smart Contract & Frontend Developer: Optimized token swap execution pathways and implemented analytical dashboards for liquidity providers.
- Cross-Platform Mobile Clients (Ongoing) — Flutter & Dart Engineer: Engineered production-ready iOS and Android mobile applications featuring responsive architecture, secure local data caching, and resilient REST & GraphQL APIs.

## Core Competencies
- Frontend & Mobile Layer: Flutter, Dart, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Responsive Architecture.
- Protocol & Smart Contracts: Solidity, EVM Compatible Networks, Fee Routing Architecture, Liquidity Management, Contract Security.
- Distributed Systems & Backend: Firebase, Node.js, Cloudflare Edge Workers, REST APIs, GraphQL Integration.
- Infrastructure & Tooling: Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD Pipelines, Multi-Chain RPC Node Management.
